test_deposits_paused_when_not_sane().details: ShariahVault.deposit() doesn't currently check isPriceSane() — a future override         would pause deposits. For now we verify the flag itself.

test_executor_bit5_crosschain_blocked().details: The RiskTieredExecutor tries deployCrossChain when destinationDomain != 0, which hits         ShariahVault.deployCrossChain → reverts NonAtomicGoldExchange.         We test this by calling deployCrossChain directly as the owner.

test_pool_within_deviation_passes().details: Pool price is set slightly BELOW oracle so the pool gives more XAUT than         oracle-estimated minOut (no slippage violation). If pool > oracle, the adapter         may get fewer tokens than its minOut estimate.

test_timelock_propose_wrong_role_reverts.details: Cache the param ID before vm.prank so the staticcall doesn't consume the prank.

failed().notice: Returns true if any test assertion has failed.

targetSenders().notice: Returns sender allowlist configured via `targetSender` (empty means no sender allowlist).

test_aggregator_accepts_index5().notice: writeScore at index 5 (GOLD_ALLOCATION) succeeds without revert.

test_aggregator_index4_still_reverts().notice: writeScore at index 4 (RWA_SUKUK / RESERVED_4) still reverts StrategyDeprecated(4).

test_combined_cap_both_adapters_at_bound.notice: Deploy 1 USDC when goldSpreadAdapter holds 290 USDC (29%): combined 291/1000 < 30%.

test_combined_cap_exceeds_reverts().notice: Deploy 10 USDC when goldSpreadAdapter holds 295 USDC (29.5%): combined 305/1000 > 30%.

test_currentValue_falls_back_to_totalDep.notice: currentValue() falls back to totalDeployed when oracle is stale.

test_currentValue_oracle_priced_when_san.notice: currentValue() returns oracle-priced value when sanity passes.

test_deploy_emits_GoldBought().notice: deploy() emits GoldBought with correct values.

test_deploy_settles_in_one_call_no_resid.notice: After deploy(), USDC balance of adapter is 0, xautHeld > 0.

test_deposits_paused_when_not_sane().notice: When oracle is stale, isPriceSane() returns false.

test_executor_bit5_crosschain_blocked().notice: Cross-chain routing reverts NonAtomicGoldExchange when goldCrossChainBlocked == true.

test_isPriceSane_false_when_deviation_to.notice: Pool price 5% off oracle (> maxDeviationBps=100) → isPriceSane() returns false.

test_isPriceSane_true_when_fresh_and_clo.notice: Fresh oracle, pool price within tolerance → isPriceSane() returns true.

test_negative_oracle_price_reverts().notice: Negative oracle price causes deploy to revert StaleGoldPrice.

test_pool_deviation_too_high_reverts().notice: Pool price 5% above oracle (5% > maxDeviationBps=100 = 1%) reverts GoldPriceDeviation.

test_pool_within_deviation_passes().notice: Pool price within 0.5% of oracle (< maxDeviationBps=100) — deploy succeeds.

test_recall_settles_in_one_call_no_resid.notice: After recall(), xautHeld == 0, USDC sent to vault.

test_slippage_reverts_when_pool_returns_.notice: When pool returns 0, deploy reverts (InsufficientOutput from pool or SlippageExceeded).

test_stale_oracle_reverts().notice: Stale oracle (updatedAt > maxStalenessSecs ago) causes deploy to revert StaleGoldPrice.

test_timelock_execute_after_30_days_succ.notice: After warp +30 days, executeParamChange succeeds and updates maxSlippageBps.

test_timelock_execute_before_delay_rever.notice: propose then execute immediately reverts TimelockNotElapsed.
